facts.fact: The World Bank's first status report on Project BRIDGE counts 510 local government administration offices connected to broadband internet, at the July 2025 baseline and unchanged at 17 December 2025, against a target of 3,428 by September 2030; it gives no total of offices.
facts.system: Facilities connected to broadband internet (BRIDGE results indicator)

facts.fact: The World Bank's results framework for BRIDGE records 510 local government administration offices as facilities connected to broadband internet at 17 December 2025; it does not say who provides or pays for the connections.
facts.system: Facilities connected to broadband internet (BRIDGE results indicator)

facts.fact: The World Bank's BRIDGE status report describes the 510 local government administration offices only as connected to broadband internet at 17 December 2025, and names no use made of the connection.
facts.system: Facilities connected to broadband internet (BRIDGE results indicator)

facts.fact: The World Bank's BRIDGE project, approved on 6 October 2025 with a US$1,590m infrastructure component, carries a results target of 3,428 local government administration offices connected to broadband by September 2030, from a baseline of 510.
facts.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth - BRIDGE (P508383)

facts.fact: The World Bank's status report shows BRIDGE financed by a US$500m IDA credit (IDA-79260), signed on 30 December 2025, not yet effective and 0 per cent disbursed at 20 January 2026.
facts.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth - BRIDGE (P508383)

facts.fact: The World Bank reports that at 17 December 2025 the number of local government administration offices connected to broadband stood at its baseline of 510, with no fibre added (0 of 90,000 km) and the special purpose vehicle not operational.
facts.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth - BRIDGE (P508383)

facts.fact: The World Bank reports that the BRIDGE credit was signed on 30 December 2025, the project implementation unit is staffed and the transaction advisory procurement has been launched, with activities expected to start in early 2026 and effectiveness planned for 27 February 2026.
facts.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth - BRIDGE (P508383)

systems.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth - BRIDGE (P508383)
systems.platform: fibre-optic network to be built by a special purpose vehicle
systems.owner: Project Implementation Unit; special purpose vehicle with private capital, not yet set up
systems.tiers: health facilities, public schools and local government administration offices in unserved and underserved areas
